page.overview:
Who is Sawblade?

A circular Sawblade, also known as a Buzz-Saw, is a weapon used by Kabal in Mortal Kombat 3 and its updates, as well as in Mortal Kombat (2011) and Mortal Kombat 11 as a special move.

Cyrax also uses a cybernetic version of the Sawblade in combos, special moves and Fatalities. Unlike Kabal's, the Sawblade that Cyrax uses is hidden and mounted on his arm or comes out of his chest. In MK 2011, his human form has the saw blades coming out of his armbands.

Triborg also uses Cyrax's Sawblades when shapeshifting into the yellow cyborg ninja in his LK-4D4 variation. It also appears in his Death Machine Fatality.

In MK11's Cyber Lin Kuei Assembly arena, from the farthest left of the stage. The kombatants can find a solitary large mechanical arm with an equally large rotating saw blade similar to Cyrax's own. The arm can also be used to smack the opponent across the face, then tear into their abdomen for an interactable Krushing Blow.
